selected_primary_idea.title: CRISP-ICF: Coherence-Resolved Instability Suppression Protocol for High-Power Laser Fusion
selected_primary_idea.summary: A multi-fidelity error, evidence, and tradeoff ledger for comparing coherent, spectral-smoothing, polarization-smoothing, and sunlight-like driver models without claiming unobserved fusion performance.
selected_primary_idea.research_object: High-power laser-driver coherence engineering for LPI control in ICF-relevant conditions
selected_primary_idea.central_hypothesis: A matched coherence descriptor and staged coupling controls can identify when a combined spectral-phase-polarization strategy merits a specialist benchmark rather than a generic claim of suppression.
selected_primary_idea.intervention: Represent candidate drivers as stochastic coherence cards; compare matched controls; then issue only conditional outcome labels after model and sensitivity checks.
falsifiers: reduced-model result presented as target-scale validation
